symptom: On Mendix 9.x and 10.0–10.9 a page passing `$currentObject` to a microflow or nanoflow was refused: `this Mendix 9.24.30 project cannot store Forms$MicroflowParameterMapping.Expression (Mendix 10.10.0+)` (29-datagrid DG12 on 9.24)
cause: bindParameterMappingValue writes an argument that is not a page/snippet parameter or widget as Expression text with Variable null. Expression is 10.10.0; before it a mapping holds only Variable (a Forms$PageVariable, required before 10.10), and Studio Pro 9 does not store an argument that is the enclosing object at all — it infers it
insight: **The floor's refusal hid a worse failure**: with the floor off, 9.24 does not load the project at all — `An error occurred when trying to set the 'Variable' property of a Microflow parameter mapping … ArgumentNullException` — so dropping only Expression would have shipped an unloadable page. **'Older shape' can be 'nothing stored'**: the 9.24 starter app and Workflow Commons 2.6.0 (9.24.0, from the Marketplace) have 82 flow calls taking 1–2 parameters and NOT ONE mapping (count calls against the called flow's parameters; an empty list alone proves nothing). So below 10.10 `$currentObject` (or an empty argument) is left out, a Variable-bound one keeps its Variable (the floor drops the empty Expression), and any other expression is refused naming the parameter. Readers needed nothing: describe already prints a call with no mappings as `call microflow M.F`, and re-executing that on 9.24 is Unchanged. Seen in passing: mxcli writes a populated Forms$CallNanoflowClientAction.ParameterMappings list with marker 3 (no RegisterListMarker for NanoflowParameterMapping), Studio Pro 2. Measured: bug-test on a fresh 9.24.30 app → exec ok, mx check 0 errors, mx convert changes no key; describe → exec Unchanged. 29-datagrid on 9.24 now stops at DG15 page variables (10.17, correct); 10.24.24 and 11.13 PASS. Tests: TestNormalize_FlowArgumentsBelowMendix10_10, TestNormalize_RefusesAnExpressionArgumentBelowMendix10_10; mdl-examples/bug-tests/1163-flow-arguments-on-mendix9.mdl
